verdict.rationale: AMD's official ROCm Core SDK applies directly to this GPU. The docs say ROCm 7.2.1 supports Radeon 9000 Series, the PyTorch and JAX install guides list the RX 9070 XT (gfx1201), and the SDK can be installed via pip, Docker, the offline runfile installer or a source build (TheRock). It also ships CUDA-equivalent HIP libraries (hipBLAS, hipFFT, hipSOLVER and others) with C, C++ and Python APIs, plus rocprofiler-sdk and debug tooling. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of SDK development on this card (the community evidence covers gaming only), per-library confirmation of gfx1201/RDNA4 support beyond the framework install pages, and Windows framework coverage beyond PyTorch.
